name: zirbel-desktop
description: Zirbel's desktop app: the editor in a window of its own, started on loopback from the built dist/.

scripts.lint: pnpm --dir .. exec oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings desktop/src desktop/test desktop/scripts
scripts.test: tsc -p . && node --test --test-timeout=120000 dist/test/routes.test.js dist/test/editor.test.js dist/test/view-game.test.js dist/test/app.js
